notes.title: Playtest V3.3 Hotfix
notes.content: Just a quick hotfix to address an RNG crash that could occur when an enemy really wanted to spawn inside of a solid object.

notes.title: Playtest Build 3.2
notes.content:
CIGS is over, and a ton of new people got to play the game, so this patch is mostly a bunch of fixes from feedback at the showcase. There's more coming, but after a bunch of work the last couple weeks and the showcase, I'm planning on taking a small break to play Silksong.

Changelog

 Obstacle sets no longer repeat in a single run if possible
 Upgrade/Ability selection now functions properly in right handed typing and numeric modes
 The Assist Mode word length slider now displays properly when opening the Assist Mode menu
 The Ability button can now be rebound for all control schemes
 Your Ability button keybind will now be shown at the start of a run (does not apply to Classic)
 Fixes a bug where the wordless firing enemy in the tutorial could still be destroyed with a word if you guessed it (this isn't realistically possible in Advanced mode, but could happen in Single Key mode accidentally)
 Enemies that spawn in with a word or letter with a partial or total match with the player's currently-typed text will properly show the match in green
 Fixed an error that would occur when spawning certain hazards

notes.title: Playtest v2.2 - Balance and Stats Beta
notes.content:
After adding new enemies, lots of balance adjustments needed to be made. One of the big issues was a significant spike in the difficulty curve around wave 10 or so of Arcade mode as the new enemies were introduced.

To address this, I've changed the way that the spawner logic works. Duplicate enemies are now generally less common, with certain enemies spawning duplicates much more rarely (particularly the big spider, which quickly can get out of hand with multiple onscreen). High enemy counts are also generally less rare, and the number and difficulty of enemies scales a bit more quickly early on, while scaling more slowly in later waves.

The other big change is the Stats beta! You can now see stats for a run at the end of a run, and all-time stats from the main menu. If you'd like to see more stats tracked, please let me know. I am tracking some stats under the hood currently that aren't exposed yet, such as counting how many times you have destroyed each specific enemy, and counts for each length of word typed. However, stats are currently universal, meaning stats are tracked the same whether you're in normal mode, hell mode, single-key mode, etc.

That's the big stuff, but there are a few other changes and additions:

 The Big Turret and Flaming Sawblade enemies have had an HP buff, and now both take 2 hits to destroy
 Rogue Mode now includes a new upgrade to increase your parry size
 Autotyper ability now has indicators for when the autotyper finishes typing a word. When it's finished, a sound effect will play and the player's text will flash green
 The Bomb enemy now is properly affected by the Scrambler
 Text flipping behavior for enemies at the top of the screen should no longer flicker up and down


As always, feel free to join the discord or DM me any feedback: https://discord.gg/GfrGtgn

notes.title: Playtest v2.1 - New Enemies!
notes.content:
The enemy code rework is done, and that means new enemies!


 Laser beam enemy fires a big laser beam
 flaming sawblades leave a trail of fire behind them
 Scrambler enemies periodically emit a field that scrambles the words above any enemy inside it! You can still type the words, though - if you remember them!
 Big Spider takes 2 hits to kill, and also lays eggs! The eggs only take 1 random character to destroy, but if you take too long, they'll hatch into a spider!


Balance has also been shifted a bunch! Generally, fewer enemies should spawn at later waves, since most enemies now have a higher "cost" for the spawner.

Also some minor updates and fixes

 Pressing Esc will now unpause
 Screenshake has been toned down, sorry about that

notes.title: Playtest Update 6.1
notes.content:
I forgot to do patch notes for Update 6, it added exploding spiders! They explode into projectiles on death. If you kill them while right next to them, you'll parry the projectiles!

This patch is for the leaderboard reset after the previous changes to the combo system! It should wipe all your local scores, and I've also reset all the online leaderboards.

Also fixed a minor tutorial bug - may still be another bug hidden in there though

notes.title: Playtest Update 5
notes.content:
Overhauled combo system
 Parry window is twice as long (up to 0.12 seconds from 0.06 seconds, or at 60fps, buffed to an 8-frame window from a 4-frame window). This makes it much more viable to parry while moving towards a projectile to intercept it.
 A successful parry grants the player 1 second of invulnerability


This is an experimental update to test out changes to the combo system. The previous combo system had no upper limit, making deep runs score very high, but also generally without much risk of losing combo. Parrying was also too difficult and not well-incentivized. 

Parrying has been significantly buffed, and also provides a big combo bonus, making parrying key to a high score.

The changes to the combo system aim to address both those problems. The new combo system starts the player at x1 multiplier, then killing enemies fills a draining combo meter which, when filled, upgrades the combo (and when it depletes, downgrades the combo) to the next tier. The tiers are x1, x2, x4, and x8.

In addition, a successful parry stacks on an additional multiplier, increasing the score tier by one, and allowing the score multiplier to reach x16. This additional multiplier lasts for 5 seconds.

If you're reading this and haven't joined the discord, please hop in and DM me to give you the Playtester role so you can join the playtester-only channel for feedback and discussion!
https://discord.gg/GfrGtgn
